name: The Scarab God
aliases: the one with the scarab head
description: An inscrutable insect god whose undead hordes fought the Phyrexians in Naktamun.

description_citations.text: "Naktamun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas's return in the Hour of Devastation kills most of the gods, leaving Hazoret, the Scarab God and the Locust God.
timeline.quote: After Bolas's return to the plane during the Hour of Devastation , the majority of the gods were killed.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas imprisons and warps three gods to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.
timeline.quote: Three other gods were imprisoned and warped by Bolas to serve his interests during the Hour of Revelation.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three sarcophagi along the Necropolis crack open and three insect-headed gods awaken.
timeline.quote: three enormous figures stepped forward from their slumber, awakened by the demon's spell.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god tears the serpent in two and advances while the other two gods enter Naktamun.
timeline.quote: the other two gods crossed the threshold of the gate into the city of Naktamun.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
timeline.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The scarab god leads thousands of blue-glazed Eternals, including past champions, out of the mausoleum.
timeline.quote: in the wake of his implacable dark divinity, came an army.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Scarab God leads the lazotep-coated dead out to transform Naktamun's people into an undead legion in the Hour of Eternity.
timeline.quote: the Scarab God led countless generations of lazotep-coated dead out from the crypt

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God and Locust God join in Bolas's plan; the Gatewatch, Hazoret, Samut and the faithful fight the Eternals.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The survivors arrive at Naktamun and find the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: they found the Scarab God and Locust God already there, engaged with the invaders

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The insect gods depart for the deep desert without a word.
timeline.quote: the inscrutable insect gods departed for the deep desert without a word

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The surviving Chitin Court gods side with the Monarchs of the Broken Lands, while the Eternal Hashaton keeps serving the Scarab God.
timeline.quote: at least the Eternal Hashaton chose to continue serving the Scarab God.

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Eternals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the Phyrexians' oil with her spear while the insect gods distract them, and Djeru's fighters dismember them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scarab and Locust Gods distract the Phyrexians while Hazoret ignites their glistening oil and Djeru's crop dismembers them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins.

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The insect gods retreat to the Broken Lands, and Hazoret helps rebuild Naktamun as the Luxa floods away the invaders' remains.
timeline.quote: the inscrutable insect gods retreated to the Broken Lands

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "Rebuilding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: They joined in enacting Bolas's plan.
relations.quote: the Scorpion God and Locust God joined the Scarab God in enacting Nicol Bolas 's plan

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She stalks the Locust God and Scarab God, though they fought the Phyrexians alongside her.
relations.quote: stalking the Locust God and the Scarab God and their Chitin Court

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Scouring the Broken Lands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: He continued serving the Scarab God.
relations.quote: at least the Eternal Hashaton chose to continue serving the Scarab God.

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Eternals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A god with the azure carapace of a scarab for a face who awakens from the Necropolis alongside the other two.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

pages_say.description: The third insect-headed god, an indigo statue who stands motionless before the Gate as Bolas flies to him.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

pages_say.description: A scarab-shaped dark god who leads the Eternals out of the central mausoleum.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

pages_say.description: A dark god who woke the Eternals and attacked the city.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.
